_about: Inland bird nests (Sal, 3 Nov 2026; MikeW's idea: an early protein source away from the shore). MikeW's fauna side places the nest spots near grouse and songbird homes and hands them to the server as items.nests_near (pos, reach) -> [{id, kind, pos}]. E at a nest (ACT_GATHER_EDGE, or items.take_nest from the fauna side) takes its eggs: a roll in count, in its seasons only. A robbed nest is empty for refill_days game days, then can be taken again that season. The grouse lays big clutches on the ground in heather and long grass; songbirds lay small clutches in bushes and low trees. Eggs are the plain egg item (boil it, or fry it with nettles in the campfire pot).
say_empty: The nest is empty. The bird may lay again in a few days.
say_season: An old nest. Nothing in it this time of year.
